name: How do you choose a detached ADU contractor in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What should homeowners look for when choosing a detached ADU contractor in Los Angeles or nearby cities?
mainEntity.text: What should homeowners look for when choosing a detached ADU contractor in Los Angeles or nearby cities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right detached ADU contractor is one of the most important decisions in the project. Homeowners should look for proven experience with new standalone units, not just remodels or generic residential work. The contractor should be able to explain how they handle feasibility, permitting, utility coordination, inspections, and change orders. They should also provide a clear scope, realistic schedule, and examples of similar lots or neighborhoods. A good contractor does more than build; they help identify the risks before construction starts. On tight urban lots, site logistics and permit coordination matter as much as framing skill. The best fit is usually the team that asks smart questions early, documents assumptions clearly, and communicates about delays before they become problems. If a contractor gives only a fast price without discussing site constraints, that is usually a warning sign.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for a contractor with detached ADU experience, strong preconstruction planning, permit coordination skills, and a clear process for allowances, inspections, and change orders. The best fit is a team that can prove it has handled similar lots and similar city reviews.
